messages:
mike: Quick poll — planning a mini evening meetup this Saturday: stargazing at Cliffside Lookout or curbside tacos + trivia at The Lantern? Which do folks prefer? :crystal_ball:
sara: both sound amazing. Leaning tacos + trivia if we can get seats.
mike: Good note. If tacos win we can grab a table at 7. If stargaze wins, meetup at 8pm for darker skies.
owen: I'm team stargaze. Easy hang and I can bring a thermos of hot cocoa. :coffee:
kai: Tacos for me — soft shell please. Also maybe afterwards some pub trivia?
jenn: Could do tacos then trivia. But if it's too chilly I might bail early. Kid's soccer in the afternoon.
lia: Weather looks clear but breezy. Cliffside is windy after sunset. Layer up.
mike: Alright doing a quick vote: reply with :taco: for tacos or :stars: for stargaze.
sara: :taco: (for the tacos!)
owen: :stars: (cocoa and constellations)
kai: :taco: +1 trivia
jenn: :taco: maybe late arrival
lia: :stars: if someone can bring a windbreaker
mike: Votes so far — tacos: 3, stars: 3. Tie! Random tie-breaker: if no one volunteers to DJ a trivia round, we'll default to stargaze. Any trivia hosts? :thinking_face:
sara: I can run a lightning 10-question round, 15 mins tops.
mike: Perfect. Then tacos + trivia it is. Plan: meet at The Lantern at 7pm; trivia starts ~8pm. If you want to caravan to Cliffside after (short walk to the overlook) ping here.
owen: I'll be at the office until 5:30, can swing by to pick up @mike. Have two seats in my car.
kai: I'll drive myself but may bring an extra blanket and a small speaker. Low volume only.
jenn: I'll aim for tacos, probably arrive ~7:30.
lia: Bringing a small first-aid kit and sun/lip balm (face for wind).
event-bot: Reminder: This event is informal. RSVP in #events if you want to be added to the group message.
mike: Sweet. If anyone wants to pre-order tacos to speed things up let me know. Otherwise see you Saturday! :sparkles:
